title: Can Instruction Fine-Tuned Language Models Identify Social Bias through Prompting?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to explicitly identify age bias through zero-shot and Chain-of-Thought prompting using a restructured conversational version of the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) dataset.
